description: This file defines the MinutesField class, which handles the representation and validation of minute-based scheduling parameters in a cron job system. It extends an abstract class and provides methods to check satisfaction, increment minutes, and validate input values.

classes.name: MinutesField
classes.description: A class that manages minute values for cron-like schedule expressions, supporting wildcards, increments, and validation.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given DateTime satisfies the minute schedule criteria.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Advances or rewinds the DateTime object by one minute, depending on the invert flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the given value matches the acceptable cron minute expression pattern.
